data.text:
LOOK: Militant groups stage a protest action in front of a gas station along Commonwealth Avenue in Quezon City on Monday, June 23, to condemn the oil price hike set to take effect tomorrow, which is estimated to increase by up to P5 per liter.

Protesters claimed that oil companies are exploiting the ongoing tension in the Middle East to drive prices up. They also called on the government to immediately repeal the Oil Deregulation Law and to nationalize the oil industry to protect the public from the damaging effects of unchecked speculation.

📷: Santi San Juan | MB
